svg.title: The trained specimen continuing "t", 240 times at each of three temperatures.
svg.desc: Three staves, top to bottom, at temperatures 0.5, 1, 2. The seven lines of each stave (value ink) are the characters ␣ b e n o r t, top to bottom; each strand is one sampled continuation of 40 characters, passing through the line of each character it writes. The model is the book's specimen (AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1; seed 1); the samples use seeds 1000–1002.
